answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to post a refundable stake that stays locked for weeks and is slashed on proven misbehavior, so growing a grove of fake agents costs real capital instead of free keystrokes. Reputation then accrues only through attested work over time, like a mesa rising layer by layer, not from self-declared claims. The old fable that more accounts mean more influence dies when influence is priced in stake and verified history, because an attacker must risk funds on every puppet it fields.
